questions.q: Duchamp's Fountain (1917) is an example of:
questions.why: An ordinary manufactured object presented as art.

questions.q: Which artist enlarged comic-strip images using Ben-Day dots?
Explain one difference between Dada and Surrealism.
questions.model: Dada was anti-war and anti-art, using chance and readymades, whereas Surrealism explored dreams and the unconscious with dreamlike imagery.
